definitions.gloss: playful; impish; mischievous in a charming way
definitions.explanation: Fond of harmless jokes and pranks in an endearing way. A compliment, often said of adults who act cute or joke around.

examples.japanese: お{茶目|ちゃめ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{茶目|ちゃめ}な⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother has a playful side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧お{茶目|ちゃめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{舌|した}→舌：02154_shita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{和|なご}んだ→和む：18058_nagomu⟧。
examples.english: The teacher playfully stuck out their tongue and laughed, and the classroom relaxed.

notes:
The base is {茶目|ちゃめ}, which is rarely used without お except in {茶目|ちゃめ}っ{気|け}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{茶目|ちゃめ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a playful person
- お{茶目|ちゃめ}な⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧: a playful side
- {茶目|ちゃめ}っ{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a playful streak

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いたずら→いたずら：01794_itazura⟧: mischief, a prank; can be unwelcome, while お{茶目|ちゃめ} is always affectionate
- ⟦{無邪気|むじゃき}→無邪気：18237_mujaki⟧: innocent, artless
